title: CipherBallot: Private Governance on BOT Chain

style.camera: screen capture with occasional zooms and callouts

scenes.visual: Open on the CipherBallot home page with the title centered and the active proposal cards visible below.
scenes.narration: CipherBallot is a private governance app migrated to BOT Chain for the builder challenge.

scenes.visual: Slow zoom into the hero and proof-oriented parts of the interface. Show the app URL briefly.
scenes.narration: It lets communities create proposals, collect private ballots, and publish verifiable results only after voting closes.

scenes.visual: Open the Proof page. Highlight chain ID 968, the deployed contract address, and the explorer link.
scenes.narration: This is running on BOT Chain testnet, with the deployed contract and live chain data shown on the proof page.

scenes.visual: Show the header button changing to Add / Switch BOT Chain after wallet connect.
scenes.narration: The wallet flow automatically adds BOT Chain to the user’s network list if it is not already there.

scenes.visual: Open the Creator Studio and scroll through proposal settings.
scenes.narration: Creators can choose a short voting window, set options, and switch between secret-sealed threshold mode and commit-reveal fallback.

scenes.visual: Focus on committee addresses, threshold approvals, and the tally secret field.
scenes.narration: For the main demo path, the creator sets committee members, a threshold, and a shared tally secret that is committed before voting starts.

scenes.visual: Create the proposal and show the transaction confirmation with explorer link.
scenes.narration: The proposal is then created on-chain, and the contract records only the secret commitment, not the plain secret.

scenes.visual: Switch to the Voter Dashboard and highlight the active proposal card.
scenes.narration: Voters see the active proposal, but not any live tally that could influence how they vote.

scenes.visual: Select an option and submit the private ballot once.
scenes.narration: In secret-sealed mode, the voter submits one private ballot transaction and is done. There is no mandatory reveal step for the voter.

scenes.visual: Show the proposal card and result page before the deadline, emphasizing that results are hidden.
scenes.narration: During the voting window, the app keeps the option tally hidden so early results do not leak into the room.

scenes.visual: After the deadline, open the Results page and the committee approval panel.
scenes.narration: Once the vote closes, committee members approve the same tally transcript on-chain using the shared tally secret.

scenes.visual: Show the tally proof hash, transcript URI, and approval counter increasing toward the threshold.
scenes.narration: The contract finalizes only when enough committee approvals match the same tally hash. Mismatched approvals are rejected.

scenes.visual: Show the finalized result bars and the proof section with explorer links.
scenes.narration: That gives us a clean audit trail on BOT Chain: the proposal, the private ballot activity, and the final verified tally.
scenes.onScreenText: Final tally verified on BOT Chain

scenes.visual: Return to the home page and show the repo and domain one last time.
scenes.narration: CipherBallot is live on cipherballot dot xyz and the code is on GitHub. This is the BOT Chain migration of an existing privacy project.

closing.visual: Static end card with contract address, explorer link, and challenge name.
closing.narration: CipherBallot brings private governance to BOT Chain with secret-sealed threshold voting and commit-reveal fallback.
